subject.title: [Bug]: Native Talk button triggers OpenAI Realtime WebRTC call and fails with 500 when Realtime is not configured

question: Should Browser/Control UI Talk be enabled from general OpenAI/provider auth auto-selection, or only from an explicit Gateway-reported realtime availability contract?
rationale: Both behaviors have compatibility impact: fail-closed explicit availability reduces confusing microphone/WebRTC failures, while implicit auto-selection may be relied on by users with working OpenAI Realtime credentials.

options.title: Gate on Gateway availability
options.body: Add a canonical Gateway capability/preflight result and make the UI disable or show an actionable message before microphone/WebRTC when realtime Talk is unavailable.

options.title: Keep implicit auto-selection with stronger preflight
options.body: Preserve general OpenAI/provider auth auto-selection but require a cheap provider readiness check and better user-facing errors before activating microphone media.

options.title: Keep current late failure behavior
options.body: Leave the Talk button visible and continue surfacing provider/WebRTC failures only after session startup, accepting the current confusion.

recommendation.title: Gate on Gateway availability
recommendation.body: Add a canonical Gateway capability/preflight result and make the UI disable or show an actionable message before microphone/WebRTC when realtime Talk is unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-main owner signal for Browser Talk, Gateway realtime session creation, and OpenAI realtime provider behavior.
